sites.name: Amani Nature Reserve (East Usambara)
sites.summary: Lowland and mid-elevation East Usambara forest – classic Eastern Arc birding with Usambara akalat, greenbuls and forest-edge species on the Amani plateau.
whyItMatters: Anchor site on multi-day Usambara modules in national endemic itineraries.
Pairs with West Usambara (Magamba) for a full East Arc list on one trip.

sites.name: West Usambara (Magamba)
sites.summary: Magamba and West Usambara escarpment forests – montane specialists and views over the Usambara–Pare block.

sites.name: Pemba Island
sites.summary: Island endemics in clove-forest mosaics – Pemba scops-owl, sunbirds and Ngezi forest specials on short flights from Dar es Salaam.

sites.name: South Pare & Chome
sites.summary: Undervisited South Pare ridges linking East Usambara travel days – forest patches and escarpment birding when routes include the Pare block.
sites.generalNotes: Included when owner confirms active routes – enquire before assuming on a fixed departure.

sites.name: Kitulo Plateau National Park
sites.summary: Montane grassland plateau ('Serengeti of flowers') with highland birds and seasonal botany – often paired with Ruaha or Mbeya legs.

sites.name: Mount Rungwe
sites.summary: Volcanic massif above Mbeya – montane forest transitions near Kitulo and Southern Highland endemics on exploratory routes.
keySpecies: Montane forest birds of the Mbeya highlands
sites.generalNotes: Offered on customised southern highland routes – confirm with us.

sites.name: Mufindi Forest
sites.summary: Cool rainforest patches above the Iringa–Mufindi escarpment – published on southern endemic itineraries with lodge-based forest birding.
keySpecies: Fruit-eaters and robin-chats in lodge forest

sites.name: Arusha National Park
sites.summary: Momella lakes, montane forest on Mount Meru skirts and Ngurdoto crater rim – strong northern starter or finisher for birding groups.

sites.name: Lake Manyara National Park
sites.summary: Rift escarpment, groundwater forest and soda lake edge – thousands of flamingos and classic Manyara forest birds on northern combination routes.

sites.name: Ngorongoro Highlands & Crater
sites.summary: Crater floor grassland birds and highland forest on the rim – combines with northern birding and wildlife itineraries.
keySpecies: Highland forest specials on the rim
